id: title:Gilbert09:never pass warehouse source credentials to hog functions

review.posthog_relevance: Prevents warehouse source credentials from being exposed or used as Hog function inputs, distinguishing warehouse ingestion from Hog function execution.
review.reason: The implementation hunk P1.F2.H1 adds a conditional check to exclude warehouse source credentials from Hog function inputs, while P1.F1.H1 provides the corresponding test. This represents a substantive, bounded correctness and security improvement: it prevents warehouse credentials from being mistakenly supplied to Hog functions, distinguishing warehouse ingestion workflows from AI
review.uncertainty: This score relies on the assumption that warehouse credentials could reach Hog inputs without this check; while the code demonstrates the safeguard, the actual risk and potential impact are not independently verified. No production incident or adoption data is available. The tier is assigned based on the presence of a clear, bounded implementation and test, not on unverified risk.}
